reason: B is the stronger proposal because it defines a composition-preserving P-for-B substitution, relevant quench/reheating conditions, baseline comparisons, and a falsifiable XRD/DSC experiment, while grounding the size-mismatch mechanism and baseline behavior in cited evidence. Its support is still indirect—neither citation establishes that B outperforms P—but A has no supporting evidence and makes less sound claims that boron is a network former and lowers the crystallization driving force.
